title: European Research and Innovation Days 2026
summary: The seventh edition of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, gathering policymakers, researchers, innovators, business leaders and civil society.
details: The two days focus on how research and innovation can strengthen Europe's competitiveness, resilience and technological sovereignty. Ekaterina Zaharieva, European Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation, is listed as opening speaker.
why: A useful event for reading the direction of EU research policy rather than for preparing a specific proposal. Applicants can use it to test ideas and meet potential partners.
